## 🇵🇹 Banco PT — Observabilidade Executiva
Métricas técnicas cruzadas com impacto financeiro real. Dashboard em tempo real.
**Canais:** MB WAY · Multibanco · Cartões · SEPA · App Mobile · Homebanking

1.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "success"
| filter isNotNull(valor_eur)
| summarize receita = sum(toDouble(valor_eur))
1.title: 💼 Receita processada (24h)

2.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| filter isNotNull(valor_eur)
| summarize perda = sum(toDouble(valor_eur))
2.title: ⚠️ Receita PERDIDA em erros (24h)

3.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| filter isNotNull(iban_origem)
| summarize afetados = countDistinctExact(iban_origem)
3.title: 👥 Clientes afetados (24h)

4.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "success"
| filter isNotNull(valor_eur)
| summarize ticket = round(avg(toDouble(valor_eur)), decimals: 2)
4.title: 💳 Ticket médio (24h)

5.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| summarize total = count()
5.title: 📊 Volume (24h)

6.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| summarize total = count(), ok = countIf(status == "success")
| fieldsAdd sucesso = round(toDouble(ok)/toDouble(total)*100, decimals: 2)
| fields sucesso
6.title: 🎯 Taxa de sucesso (24h)

8.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-6h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| filter isNotNull(valor_eur)
| summarize perda_eur = sum(toDouble(valor_eur)), by:{bin(timestamp, 5m)}
8.title: Receita perdida ao longo do tempo (€) — 6h

9.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| filter isNotNull(error_code)
| filter isNotNull(valor_eur)
| summarize ocorrencias = count(), impacto_eur = round(sum(toDouble(valor_eur)), decimals: 2), ticket_medio = round(avg(toDouble(valor_eur)), decimals: 2), by:{codigo_erro = error_code}
| sort impacto_eur, direction:"descending"
| limit 10
9.title: Top erros por IMPACTO FINANCEIRO (€) — 24h

10.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "success"
| filter isNotNull(valor_eur)
| summarize receita_eur = round(sum(toDouble(valor_eur)), decimals: 2), volume = count(), by:{canal}
| sort receita_eur, direction:"descending"
10.title: Receita por canal (24h) — €

11.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| summarize total = count(), sucesso = countIf(status == "success"), erros = countIf(status == "error"), perda_eur = if(isNull(sum(if(status == "error", toDouble(valor_eur), null))), 0, sum(if(status == "error", toDouble(valor_eur), null))), by:{canal}
| fieldsAdd taxa_erro_pct = round(toDouble(erros)/toDouble(total)*100, decimals: 2)
| sort perda_eur, direction:"descending"
11.title: Volume × Perda por canal (24h)

13.title: Transações/min: sucesso vs erro (1h)

14.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| summarize p50 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 50), p95 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 95), p99 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 99), by:{bin(timestamp, 1m)}
14.title: Latência P50 / P95 / P99 — todos os canais (1h)

15.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| summarize total = count(), ok = countIf(status == "success"), erros = countIf(status == "error"), by:{canal}
| fieldsAdd sla_pct = round(toDouble(ok)/toDouble(total)*100, decimals: 3)
| fields canal, total, erros, sla_pct
| sort sla_pct
15.title: SLA por canal (24h)

16.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| summarize p50 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 50), p95 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 95), p99 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 99), by:{canal}
| sort p95, direction:"descending"
16.title: Latência por canal (1h) — ms

17.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "success"
| filter isNotNull(valor_eur)
| filter isNotNull(perfil_cliente)
| summarize receita_eur = round(sum(toDouble(valor_eur)), decimals: 2), transacoes = count(), by:{perfil_cliente}
| sort receita_eur, direction:"descending"
17.title: Receita por perfil de cliente (24h)

19.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.fraude"
| filter status == "blocked"
| filter isNotNull(valor_tentado_eur)
| summarize valor_bloqueado = sum(toDouble(valor_tentado_eur))
19.title: 💸 Valor bloqueado em fraude (24h) — €

20.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.fraude"
| summarize total = count(), bloqueadas = countIf(status == "blocked")
| fieldsAdd eficiencia = round(toDouble(bloqueadas)/toDouble(total)*100, decimals: 1)
| fields eficiencia
20.title: 🎯 Eficiência anti-fraude (24h)

21.title: Tentativas de fraude (6h) — total vs bloqueadas

22.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-6h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.auth"
| filter pais_origem != "PT"
| filter isNotNull(pais_origem)
| summarize tentativas = count(), sucesso = countIf(status == "success"), falhas = countIf(status == "failed"), by:{pais = pais_origem}
| sort tentativas, direction:"descending"
22.title: Acessos a partir do estrangeiro (6h)

23.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.auth"
| filter status == "failed"
| summarize falhas = count(), by:{bin(timestamp, 5m)}
23.title: Falhas de autenticação (1h)

25.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-30m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| fields timestamp, canal, servico, error_code, valor_eur, latencia_ms, iban = iban_origem
| sort timestamp, direction:"descending"
| limit 20
25.title: Últimas 20 transações com erro (30min)

26.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| filter isNotNull(error_code)
| summarize ocorrencias = count(), impacto_eur = round(sum(toDouble(valor_eur)), decimals: 2), by:{canal, codigo = error_code}
| sort ocorrencias, direction:"descending"
26.title: Distribuição de erros: canal × código (1h)
